```{r compile csvs into one}
#!/usr/bin/env Rscript

# ============================================================
# Merge A4 cognition + CDR by subject and visit
#   - Full outer join on BID + visit code
#   - Harmonizes cognition VISIT to VISCODE
#   - Adds BaselinepTau217 = first available ORRESRAW per BID
#     using the lowest numeric VISCODE in biomarker file
#   - Saves merged dataset
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tidyr)
})

# ============================================================
# PATHS
# ============================================================

cog_path <- '/Users/caseyvanderlip/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-SharedLibraries-UCIrvine/Starklab - Documents/Casey/A4/shortertrials/data/A4_cognition_clean.csv'
cdr_path <- '/Users/caseyvanderlip/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-SharedLibraries-UCIrvine/Starklab - Documents/Casey/A4/shortertrials/data/cdr.csv'
ptau_path <- '/Users/caseyvanderlip/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-SharedLibraries-UCIrvine/Starklab - Documents/Casey/A4/A4_Study_Data/External Data/biomarker_pTau217.csv'

outdir <- "/Users/caseyvanderlip/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-SharedLibraries-UCIrvine/Starklab - Documents/Casey/A4/shortertrials/data"
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

outfile <- file.path(outdir, "A4_c3_cdr_baseline_ptau217.csv")

# ============================================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================

clean_viscode <- function(x) {
  # Handles values like 1, "1", "V01", "v04", "sc1b", etc.
  # For standard numeric visit codes, returns numeric value.
  x_chr <- as.character(x)
  x_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x_chr))
  
  needs_parse <- is.na(x_num) & !is.na(x_chr)
  x_num[needs_parse] <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(str_extract(x_chr[needs_parse], "\\d+"))
  )
  
  x_num
}

# ============================================================
# READ FILES
# ============================================================

cog <- read_csv(cog_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
cdr <- read_csv(cdr_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
ptau <- read_csv(ptau_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

cat("\n[INFO] Cognition rows:", nrow(cog), " cols:", ncol(cog), "\n")
cat("[INFO] CDR rows:", nrow(cdr), " cols:", ncol(cdr), "\n")
cat("[INFO] pTau rows:", nrow(ptau), " cols:", ncol(ptau), "\n")

# ============================================================
# STANDARDIZE IDs AND VISIT CODES
# ============================================================

cog_clean <- cog %>%
  mutate(
    BID = as.character(BID),
    VISCODE = clean_viscode(VISIT)
  )

cdr_clean <- cdr %>%
  mutate(
    BID = as.character(BID),
    VISCODE = clean_viscode(VISCODE)
  )

ptau_clean <- ptau %>%
  mutate(
    BID = as.character(BID),
    VISCODE = clean_viscode(VISCODE),
    ORRESRAW = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ORRESRAW))
  )

# ============================================================
# CHECK FOR DUPLICATES BEFORE MERGE
# ============================================================

cog_dupes <- cog_clean %>%
  count(BID, VISCODE) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

cdr_dupes <- cdr_clean %>%
  count(BID, VISCODE) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

cat("\n[INFO] Duplicate BID/VISCODE rows in cognition:", nrow(cog_dupes), "\n")
cat("[INFO] Duplicate BID/VISCODE rows in CDR:", nrow(cdr_dupes), "\n")

if (nrow(cog_dupes) > 0) {
  cat("[WARN] Cognition has duplicate BID/VISCODE rows. Keeping first row per BID/VISCODE.\n")
}

if (nrow(cdr_dupes) > 0) {
  cat("[WARN] CDR has duplicate BID/VISCODE rows. Keeping first row per BID/VISCODE.\n")
}

cog_one <- cog_clean %>%
  arrange(BID, VISCODE) %>%
  group_by(BID, VISCODE) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

cdr_one <- cdr_clean %>%
  arrange(BID, VISCODE) %>%
  group_by(BID, VISCODE) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

# ============================================================
# CREATE BASELINE PTAU217
# ============================================================
# BaselinepTau217 = first non-missing ORRESRAW per subject,
# ordered by lowest VISCODE.
# If there are multiple rows at the same VISCODE, uses the first.

baseline_ptau <- ptau_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(BID), !is.na(VISCODE), !is.na(ORRESRAW)) %>%
  arrange(BID, VISCODE) %>%
  group_by(BID) %>%
  summarise(
    BaselinepTau217 = first(ORRESRAW),
    BaselinepTau217_VISCODE = first(VISCODE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\n[INFO] Subjects with baseline pTau217:", nrow(baseline_ptau), "\n")

# ============================================================
# FULL OUTER MERGE COGNITION + CDR
# ============================================================

merged <- full_join(
  cog_one,
  cdr_one,
  by = c("BID", "VISCODE"),
  suffix = c("_cog", "_cdr")
) %>%
  left_join(baseline_ptau, by = "BID") %>%
  arrange(BID, VISCODE)

# ============================================================
# OPTIONAL CLEANUP
# ============================================================
# Keep original VISIT from cognition if present, but VISCODE is the merged visit variable.
# You can uncomment this if you do not want special visits:
#
# merged <- merged %>%
#   filter(is.na(VISCODE) | VISCODE < 997)

# ============================================================
# QUICK SUMMARY
# ============================================================

cat("\n[INFO] Final merged rows:", nrow(merged), "\n")
cat("[INFO] Final merged cols:", ncol(merged), "\n")
cat("[INFO] Unique subjects:", n_distinct(merged$BID), "\n")

cat("\n[INFO] Rows with cognition data:",
    sum(!is.na(merged$C3) | !is.na(merged$C3Mem) | !is.na(merged$C3NonMem)),
    "\n")

cat("[INFO] Rows with CDR data:",
    sum(!is.na(merged$CDRSB) | !is.na(merged$CDGLOBAL)),
    "\n")

cat("[INFO] Rows with BaselinepTau217:",
    sum(!is.na(merged$BaselinepTau217)),
    "\n")

cat("\n[INFO] Baseline pTau217 visit distribution:\n")
print(
  merged %>%
    distinct(BID, BaselinepTau217_VISCODE) %>%
    count(BaselinepTau217_VISCODE, sort = TRUE)
)

# ============================================================
# SAVE
# ============================================================

write_csv(merged, outfile)

cat("\n[DONE] Saved merged file to:\n", outfile, "\n")


```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r correlate C3 with ptau217, echo=FALSE}
#!/usr/bin/env Rscript

# ============================================================
# Correlate baseline C3 measures with baseline pTau217
#   - Uses merged CSV: A4_c3_cdr_baseline_ptau217.csv
#   - Keeps baseline cognition rows only
#   - Baseline cognition = lowest non-special VISCODE per BID with cognition data
#   - Faceted scatterplot
#   - Prints plot only; does not save
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(purrr)
  library(tibble)
})

# ============================================================
# PATH
# ============================================================

infile <- "/Users/caseyvanderlip/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-SharedLibraries-UCIrvine/Starklab - Documents/Casey/A4/shortertrials/data/A4_c3_cdr_baseline_ptau217.csv"

# ============================================================
# VARIABLES
# ============================================================

c3_vars <- c(
  "BPXT",
  "FNMT",
  "OCL",
  "DET",
  "IDN",
  "ONB",
  "C3",
  "C3Mem",
  "C3NonMem"
)

measure_labels <- c(
  BPXT = "BPXT",
  FNMT = "FNMT",
  OCL = "OCL",
  DET = "DET",
  IDN = "IDN",
  ONB = "ONB",
  C3 = "C3",
  C3Mem = "C3 Memory",
  C3NonMem = "C3 Non-Memory"
)

# ============================================================
# HELPERS
# ============================================================

safe_cor_test <- function(dat) {
  dat <- dat %>%
    filter(!is.na(BaselinepTau217), !is.na(score))
  
  if (nrow(dat) < 3) {
    return(tibble(
      n = nrow(dat),
      r = NA_real_,
      p = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  
  test <- suppressWarnings(
    cor.test(dat$BaselinepTau217, dat$score, method = "pearson")
  )
  
  tibble(
    n = nrow(dat),
    r = unname(test$estimate),
    p = test$p.value
  )
}

format_p <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ "p = NA",
    p < 0.001 ~ "p < 0.001",
    TRUE ~ paste0("p = ", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3))
  )
}

# ============================================================
# READ
# ============================================================

dat <- read_csv(infile, show_col_types = FALSE)

missing_vars <- setdiff(c(c3_vars, "BID", "VISCODE", "BaselinepTau217"), names(dat))

if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required columns from merged file: ",
    paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# ============================================================
# BASELINE COGNITION ROW PER SUBJECT
# ============================================================
# Uses lowest non-special VISCODE with at least one C3 measure present.
# Excludes 997 and 999 from baseline cognition selection.

baseline_dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    BID = as.character(BID),
    VISCODE = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(VISCODE)),
    BaselinepTau217 = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(BaselinepTau217))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(BID),
    !is.na(VISCODE),
    VISCODE < 997,
    !is.na(BaselinepTau217)
  ) %>%
  filter(if_any(all_of(c3_vars), ~ !is.na(.x))) %>%
  arrange(BID, VISCODE) %>%
  group_by(BID) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("\n[INFO] Baseline rows used:", nrow(baseline_dat), "\n")
cat("[INFO] Unique subjects used:", n_distinct(baseline_dat$BID), "\n")

# ============================================================
# LONG FORMAT
# ============================================================

plot_dat <- baseline_dat %>%
  select(BID, VISCODE, BaselinepTau217, all_of(c3_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(c3_vars),
    names_to = "measure",
    values_to = "score"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    score = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(score)),
    measure = factor(measure, levels = c3_vars, labels = measure_labels[c3_vars])
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(BaselinepTau217), !is.na(score))

# ============================================================
# CORRELATIONS
# ============================================================

cor_labels <- plot_dat %>%
  group_by(measure) %>%
  group_modify(~ safe_cor_test(.x)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      "r = ", formatC(r, format = "f", digits = 2),
      "\n", format_p(p),
      "\nn = ", n
    )
  )

print(cor_labels)

label_positions <- plot_dat %>%
  group_by(measure) %>%
  summarise(
    x = quantile(BaselinepTau217, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    y = quantile(score, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(cor_labels, by = "measure")

# ============================================================
# FACET PLOT
# ============================================================

p <- ggplot(plot_dat, aes(x = BaselinepTau217, y = score)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.35, size = 1.4) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE,
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = label_positions,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1,
    size = 3.4
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ measure, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  labs(
    x = "Baseline plasma pTau217",
    y = "Baseline cognition score",
    title = "Baseline C3 cognition measures vs baseline pTau217"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )

print(p)

```



```{r}
#!/usr/bin/env Rscript

# ============================================================
# Longitudinal C3 cognition by Converter vs Nonconverter
#   - Uses merged CSV:
#     A4_c3_cdr_baseline_ptau217.csv
#   - Defines A4 participants from any row with SUBSTUDY == "A4"
#   - Requires participants to have CDGLOBAL at VISCODE 66
#   - Converter = CDGLOBAL >= 0.5 at VISCODE 66
#   - Nonconverter = CDGLOBAL < 0.5 at VISCODE 66
#   - Plots all available C3 visits through VISCODE 66,
#     even if CDR is missing at that visit
#   - Prints plot only; does not save
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(tibble)
})

# ============================================================
# PATH
# ============================================================

infile <- "/Users/caseyvanderlip/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-SharedLibraries-UCIrvine/Starklab - Documents/Casey/A4/shortertrials/data/A4_c3_cdr_baseline_ptau217.csv"

# ============================================================
# VARIABLES
# ============================================================

c3_vars <- c(
  "BPXT",
  "FNMT",
  "OCL",
  "DET",
  "IDN",
  "ONB",
  "C3",
  "C3Mem",
  "C3NonMem"
)

measure_labels <- c(
  BPXT = "BPXT",
  FNMT = "FNMT",
  OCL = "OCL",
  DET = "DET",
  IDN = "IDN",
  ONB = "ONB",
  C3 = "C3",
  C3Mem = "C3 Memory",
  C3NonMem = "C3 Non-Memory"
)

# ============================================================
# READ DATA
# ============================================================

dat <- read_csv(infile, show_col_types = FALSE)

required_cols <- c("BID", "VISCODE", "SUBSTUDY", "CDGLOBAL", c3_vars)

missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(dat))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required columns from merged file: ",
    paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# ============================================================
# CLEAN DATA
# ============================================================

dat_clean <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    BID = as.character(BID),
    SUBSTUDY = as.character(SUBSTUDY),
    VISCODE = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(VISCODE)),
    CDGLOBAL = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(CDGLOBAL))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(BID),
    !is.na(VISCODE),
    VISCODE <= 66
  )

# ============================================================
# DEFINE A4 PARTICIPANTS
# ============================================================
# Important:
# SUBSTUDY may be missing on cognition-only rows after the full outer merge.
# So define A4 status at the participant level first.

a4_ids <- dat_clean %>%
  filter(SUBSTUDY == "A4") %>%
  distinct(BID)

cat("\n[INFO] A4 participants identified:", nrow(a4_ids), "\n")

# ============================================================
# DEFINE CONVERTER STATUS AT VISCODE 66
# ============================================================
# Uses only A4 participants.
# Requires CDGLOBAL at VISCODE 66.
# Converter = CDGLOBAL >= 0.5 at VISCODE 66.

converter_status <- dat_clean %>%
  semi_join(a4_ids, by = "BID") %>%
  filter(VISCODE == 66) %>%
  filter(!is.na(CDGLOBAL)) %>%
  group_by(BID) %>%
  summarise(
    CDGLOBAL_66 = max(CDGLOBAL, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ConverterStatus = if_else(
      CDGLOBAL_66 >= 0.5,
      "Converter",
      "Nonconverter"
    ),
    ConverterStatus = factor(
      ConverterStatus,
      levels = c("Nonconverter", "Converter")
    )
  )

cat("[INFO] A4 participants with VISCODE 66 CDGLOBAL:", nrow(converter_status), "\n")
cat("[INFO] Converter status counts:\n")
print(table(converter_status$ConverterStatus, useNA = "ifany"))

# ============================================================
# KEEP ALL C3 VISITS THROUGH VISCODE 66 FOR ELIGIBLE SUBJECTS
# ============================================================
# This is the key change:
# after converter status is defined, go back to all rows for those people
# and keep C3 visits even if CDGLOBAL/CDR is missing at that visit.

analysis_dat <- dat_clean %>%
  semi_join(converter_status, by = "BID") %>%
  left_join(converter_status, by = "BID") %>%
  filter(
    VISCODE <= 66,
    if_any(all_of(c3_vars), ~ !is.na(.x))
  )

cat("\n[INFO] Longitudinal C3 rows among eligible A4 subjects:", nrow(analysis_dat), "\n")
cat("[INFO] Unique eligible A4 subjects:", n_distinct(analysis_dat$BID), "\n")

cat("\n[INFO] Visit distribution among eligible A4 subjects with any C3 data:\n")
print(
  analysis_dat %>%
    count(VISCODE, sort = FALSE)
)

cat("\n[INFO] Visit distribution by converter status:\n")
print(
  analysis_dat %>%
    count(VISCODE, ConverterStatus, sort = FALSE)
)

# ============================================================
# LONG FORMAT
# ============================================================

plot_dat <- analysis_dat %>%
  select(BID, VISCODE, ConverterStatus, all_of(c3_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(c3_vars),
    names_to = "measure",
    values_to = "score"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    score = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(score)),
    measure = factor(
      measure,
      levels = c3_vars,
      labels = measure_labels[c3_vars]
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(score),
    !is.na(ConverterStatus)
  )

# ============================================================
# SUMMARY DATA: MEAN AND SEM BY VISCODE/GROUP/MEASURE
# ============================================================

summary_dat <- plot_dat %>%
  group_by(measure, VISCODE, ConverterStatus) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n_distinct(BID),
    mean_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_score = sd(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem_score = sd_score / sqrt(n),
    lower = mean_score - sem_score,
    upper = mean_score + sem_score,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\n[INFO] Summary sample sizes:\n")
print(
  summary_dat %>%
    select(measure, VISCODE, ConverterStatus, n) %>%
    arrange(measure, VISCODE, ConverterStatus)
)

# ============================================================
# PLOT
# ============================================================

p <- ggplot(
  summary_dat,
  aes(
    x = VISCODE,
    y = mean_score,
    group = ConverterStatus,
    linetype = ConverterStatus,
    shape = ConverterStatus
  )
) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      ymin = lower,
      ymax = upper,
      fill = ConverterStatus
    ),
    alpha = 0.18,
    color = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 2.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ measure, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = sort(unique(summary_dat$VISCODE))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "VISCODE",
    y = "Mean C3 cognition score ± SEM",
    title = "Longitudinal C3 measures by conversion status",
    linetype = "Group",
    shape = "Group",
    fill = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

print(p)
```
